instrument: Playwright (Python sync API) driving headed Chromium; the Playwright MCP browser dropped its connection on every download event (instrument failure, twice), so downloads were driven directly
server: uvicorn autotester.ui.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8041, from a throwaway git-archive HEAD copy + the 2 unit files outside D:/autoTesting (routes_report.__file__ verified inside the copy); stopped after the journey
data: isolated AUTOTESTER_ROOT in the session scratchpad; synthetic projects only: withruns (run_1 PASS, run_2 FAIL seeded via ProjectStore + a crawl_latest dir), noruns (no runs/), crawlonly (runs/crawl_latest only). No real project copied or served.
